text:
Nina Ortiz: Quick brief for Tuesday's launch funnel assets. Need: 1 inbound routing schematic, 3 benchmark micro-tiles, 1 slide hero template. Low lift, brand-safe.
Caleb Wu: Ack. Can you paste the copy and preferred sizes?
Nina Ortiz: Copy (edit as needed):
- Tile 1: 'Consistent low latency at scale'
- Tile 2: 'Reduce inference $/token with caching'
- Tile 3: '99th percentile within SLA'
Routing steps: form -> edge -> smart router -> model variants -> cache/fallback -> monitoring -> SDR queue. Show two automatic fallbacks: model downgrade and cross-region.
Maya Rao: Suggest Tile 3 -> 'P99 within SLA (target 95%)' and Tile 1 -> 'Predictable low latency'. Also need social crop and speaker slide.
Designbot: ETA: tiles in 24h, schematic + slides in 48h. Deliverables: PNG 1200x1200 @2x, SVGs, Figma file. Will include brand, muted, and high-contrast palettes plus alt text. Filename pattern?
Nina Ortiz: Use: launch2025_tile_latency_v1.png, launch2025_schematic_v1.svg, launch2025_slidehero_v1.fig. Include editable layers.
Legalbot: Quick pass: copy is okay, avoid absolute guarantees or competitor mentions. Ensure no customer data in schematic.
Designbot: Noted. I'll add an export checklist and tag @Maya Rao & @Legalbot in Figma.
Caleb Wu: Also add a tiny legend for routing icons and a telemetry overlay layer.
Designbot: Adding legend + telemetry layer. Will post Figma link when first pass is ready.
Nina Ortiz: Thanks — aiming to queue assets into the launch play once approved. :rocket:
